import novamind_api as nm

# For each 7-day window, scheduled rebills by class:
# due iff r=(lo-start_day)%30 ==0 or >=24 (valid for 7-day window)
# first_rebill iff start_day between lo-30 and hi-30
windows = [(218,224,'wk32'),(225,231,'wk33'),(232,238,'wk34'),(239,245,'wk35'),(246,252,'wk36'),(253,259,'wk37')]
for lo,hi,name in windows:
    r = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN c.group_id='S2' AND s.start_day <= 125 THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) s2_vet,
      SUM(CASE WHEN c.group_id='S2' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 126 AND {lo-31} THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) s2_mid,
      SUM(CASE WHEN c.group_id='S2' AND s.start_day BETWEEN {lo-30} AND {hi-30} THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) s2_first,
      SUM(CASE WHEN c.group_id='S3' THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) s3_all,
      COUNT(*) n
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
      AND ((({lo} - s.start_day) % 30 = 0) OR (({lo} - s.start_day) % 30 >= 24))
      AND s.start_day < {lo}
    """)
    row = r['rows'][0]
    v = row['s2_vet'] or 0; m = row['s2_mid'] or 0; f = row['s2_first'] or 0; s3 = row['s3_all'] or 0
    print(f"{name} d{lo}-{hi}: S2vet ${v/1e6:.3f}M S2mid ${m/1e6:.3f}M S2first ${f/1e6:.3f}M S3 ${s3/1e6:.3f}M total ${ (v+m+f+s3)/1e6:.3f}M n={row['n']}")

import novamind_api as nm

print("=== 1. BOOK by group/plan (subscribed) ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.plan p, COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.effective_price) mrr
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY g,p ORDER BY mrr DESC""")
tot_n=0; tot_m=0
for row in r['rows']:
    tot_n+=row['n']; tot_m+=row['mrr']
    if row['n']>200: print(f"  {row['g']}-{row['p']}: {row['n']} subs ${round(row['mrr'])}")
print(f"  TOTAL: {tot_n} subs ${round(tot_m)} MRR")

print("=== 2. LEADS d211-217 by group: arrivals & conversion ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n,
SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) conv
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 211 AND 217 GROUP BY g ORDER BY n DESC""")
for row in r['rows']:
    if row['n']>20: print(f"  {row['g']}: {row['n']} leads, {row['conv']} conv ({100*row['conv']/row['n']:.1f}%)")

print("=== 3. FIRST PAYMENTS d211-217 ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.plan p, COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.effective_price) rev
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 211 AND 217 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
GROUP BY g,p ORDER BY rev DESC""")
ft=0
for row in r['rows']:
    ft+=row['rev']
    if row['n']>20: print(f"  {row['g']}-{row['p']}: {row['n']} ${round(row['rev'])}")
print(f"  TOTAL firsts: ${round(ft)}")

print("=== 4. Leads by acquisition_source d211-217 (ind only) ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.acquisition_source src, c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n
FROM customers c WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 211 AND 217 AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY src, g ORDER BY n DESC""")
for row in r['rows']:
    if row['n']>10: print(f"  {row['src']} / {row['g']}: {row['n']}")

import novamind_api as nm

print("=== ft_pre tail: vintages d174-187, first-rebill survival ===")
# first rebill happens ~30d after start; those rebilling d211-217 started d181-187
for lo,hi in [(174,180),(181,187)]:
    r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) alive
      FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
      WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') AND c.group_id='S2'
      GROUP BY g""")
    for row in r['rows']:
        print(f"  vintage d{lo}-{hi}: {row['n']} firsts, {row['alive']} alive ({100*row['alive']/row['n']:.1f}%)")

print("=== S2 2nd-rebill check: d160-166 vintage still alive? ===")

import novamind_api as nm
# Decompose wk36/wk37 'mid' sched into tested (first rebill passed by d217) vs untested vintages
for lo,hi,name in [(246,252,'wk36'),(253,259,'wk37')]:
    r = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 126 AND 187 THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) tested,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 188 AND {lo-31} THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) untested
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S2'
      AND ((({lo} - s.start_day) % 30 = 0) OR (({lo} - s.start_day) % 30 >= 24))
      AND s.start_day BETWEEN 126 AND {lo-31}
    """)
    row = r['rows'][0]
    print(f"{name}: mid tested ${ (row['tested'] or 0)/1e6:.3f}M | untested(first-rebill pending) ${ (row['untested'] or 0)/1e6:.3f}M")
